notes: The agent delivered a functionally working user board implementation with passing tests (8/8), proper CLI integration, and confirmed paia-events connectivity. However, the work has several significant concerns: (1) FLIP verification failed at 0.41 vs. 0.70 threshold—a 41% shortfall suggesting the implementation may not align with specification intent despite functional correctness; (2) coredrift warnings (dependency_drift, hardening_in_core) were flagged but not explicitly addressed; (3) task was recovered from orphaned state, indicating coordination issues; (4) no formal artifacts were recorded despite implementation existing, making handoff implicit rather than explicit; (5) task spec had no explicit acceptance criteria (empty acceptance array), making it unclear whether the implementation truly satisfies requirements. The work demonstrates technical competence (quick turnaround, leveraged existing code, tests passing) but falls short on verification, coordination, and specification alignment. Score reflects 'Meets Expectations'—acceptable functional delivery with notable deficiencies in verification and process.
